_comment: pi-net-resume: auto-continue a pi session after a network outage.
Copy this to <agent dir>/extensions/pi-net-resume/config.json to customise.
The agent dir is ~/.pi/agent unless PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR says otherwise.
Every key is optional; anything missing uses the built-in default.
continueMessage: The network is back (Wi-Fi reconnected). Continue the task from where it was interrupted; do not repeat steps that already completed. If anything from the last step is uncertain, say so briefly before continuing.
errorPattern: network|fetch failed|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNABORTED|ETIMEDOUT|EHOSTUNREACH|ENETUNREACH|socket hang up|other side closed|getaddrinfo|connection (refused|lost|reset|closed|error)|reset before headers|upstream connect|timed? ?out|timeout|terminated|websocket|dns
excludePattern: usage limit|insufficient_quota|out of budget|quota|billing|rate.?limit|too many requests|\b429\b|unauthorized|invalid api key|authentication
hardNetworkPattern: ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNABORTED|ENETUNREACH|EHOSTUNREACH|ENETDOWN|NETRESET|EPIPE|EPROTO|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|EAI_FAIL|getaddrinfo|fetch failed|socket hang up|other side closed|reset before headers|network is unreachable|no route to host|name or service not known|temporary failure in name resolution|dns lookup failed|connect(ion)? (refused|lost|reset|timed? ?out)
